_method: Derived from real ERA5 growing-season anomalies per field-season, by evaluation/climate_shock_benchmark/derive_labels.py. Regenerate with `python -m evaluation.climate_shock_benchmark.derive_labels` and copy the result here - do not hand-edit.

_thresholds.drought: growing-season precipitation < 0.75x the field's own climatology
_thresholds.wet_extreme: growing-season precipitation > 1.30x the field's own climatology

_coverage: 7 real fields across Tamil Nadu, Punjab, West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh; rice and wheat. Seasons extending beyond the ingested ERA5 record are excluded rather than labelled, so a truncated season is never misread as a drought.
